label: Effective delivery through an interrupted borrower-only order and q44 source supply
summary: Compared the q44 distinct actual OwnBeing cause with a strengthened infinite borrower-only account in docs/notes/q44-inferential-dependency.md#can-effective-local-supply-continue-throughout-a-borrower-only-order. The earlier guarded state-indexed tail leaves multiple populated suffixes possible. Strengthening its law to effective delivery at an intact link gives an exact arbitrary-interruption criterion. Population is possible iff some upstream suffix is intact. In any populated solution, x is active iff every link at or above x is intact. Each such x has an actual distinct neighbour under the existing tailAtState profile. All surviving local responses are compatible with the explicit interpretation OwnBeing nowhere, so the q44 conclusion is not forced by selection and transmission. Unbounded interruptions eliminate the populated solution, whereas a separately posited active input can sustain an isolated lower segment. The difference is independence of that channel, not existential independence. Proof and exact reproduction command are linked in the note (Scratch/q44-borrowed-supply/InterruptedTransmission.lean, local Lean check, unregistered). This is an analyst's structural intervention model, not a counterexample to real productive existential borrowing or a defeat of supplier completeness. The cut-surviving input could borrow its actuality elsewhere. The conditional case for a nonborrowed giver rests on the received-as-produced demand for an account of the order’s productive exercise and on the proposal that an intrinsically actual giver exercises its power toward these recipients. The primitive populated-order rival explains its member responses and survives. Existing q44 composition, reception, ancestry and source-selection obligations remain. No new registered entailment, source attribution or formal premise change.
blocker: Investigate what grounds the actual exercise in a particular supplier-complete esse cone at matching scope: a giver whose intrinsic actuality suffices for giving to this recipient, or a concrete governing whole that realizes its members' exercise. An active input that survives a channel cut is only relatively independent. Local interventions do not establish collective rootedness, OwnBeing, common selection or that the existential relation has this transmission semantics.
